title: Light Ethiopian Plant-Based Bereeka
description: A light and flavorful ethiopian dish featuring red wine jelly, long-fermentation-dough, and plant-based-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Combine red wine jelly, onion, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan over medium heat, whisking until smooth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, mix the long-fermentation dough with teff flour and water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Shape the dough into small balls and flatten slightly into disks.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the dough disks for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned.
Add the cauliflower florets to the skillet and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Bereeka hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Reheat the red wine jelly sauce and serve alongside the Bereeka.
